title: A quasi-compact locally closed subset with retrocompact complement in a nice basis is constructible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a criterion for constructibility of a locally closed subset (author lemma at source lines 3010-3018, label lemma-locally-closed-constructible-image): in a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens closed under finite intersections, a quasi-compact locally closed subset whose complement is retrocompact is constructible. The proof (source lines 3020-3030) uses the basis hypothesis in an essential way to write the subset as the intersection of its closure with a quasi-compact open (proof lines 3021-3023), and then reduces the constructibility to the retrocompactness of the difference inside that open (proof lines 3023-3027), which is where the hypothesis on the complement enters. H2.
